title: Fix math model in nts/core.py: t-test on coded coefs with s_v = sqrt(s2_vos / N)
description: Replace lines 296-307 of nts/core.py. Compute t0, t1, t2 against b0_coded, b1_coded, b2_coded (the coefficients the regression equation is built from, per Методичка §3). s_v = sqrt(s2_vos / N) where N=4 (orthogonal 2-factor plan, S{b}² = s²_вос / N). Keep sign_b based on coded b's so b_coded carries through the regression equation. Expose natural b's under coefficients_v but DO NOT drive the t-test from them.
acceptance_criteria: sign_b0/b1/b2 derived from coded t0/t1/t2 (so equation uses coded form)
Internal unit test on examples/default.json: t0,t1,t2 positive; sign consistent; F-value and F_crit relation unchanged
`python -m nts.cli --input examples/default.json` no longer raises KeyError (after T1+T3)
context: Методичка.docx §3, абзацы 517-540 (b0/b1/b2 в кодированной форме). Verified: t0=23.185, t1=0.658, t2=1.472 on examples/default.json.
